## Description

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft is looking for a Legislative Counsel to join our fast-growing and fast-paced team. Based in Washington D.C this stellar individual will be directly involved in shaping the policy framework for the evolving ridesharing industry as a pivotal part of our Public Policy team.

#### Responsibilities:

- Provide legal expertise to Lyft’s Public Policy team on legislative issues.
- Track, analyze, and evaluate proposed legislation across topic areas, identifying risks and opportunities.
- Draft legislative language, amendments, and recommendations that reflect the interests of Lyft’s users and business.
- Identify legislative trends and develop responsive strategies across subject matters and jurisdictions.
- Collaborate cross-functionally to assess legislative impacts and inform decision-making.
- Partner with Lyft’s regional Public Policy team members on market-specific legislative efforts.
- Develop leading expertise on a specific issue area, in coordination with their manager.
- Coordinate with Lyft’s compliance, legal, and operations teams as new regulatory frameworks are implemented.

#### Experience:

- Law degree required.
- 5+ years of experience with legislative drafting for a local, state and/or federal legislative body, or at a trade association or company.
- Exceptional ability to critically analyze policy and legal issues.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, demanding (and sometimes unstructured) environment.
- Self-starter; intrinsically motivated.
- Experience with insurance, transportation, technology, AI, privacy, or labor and employment law a plus but not required

#### Benefits:

- Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
- Mental health benefits
- Family building benefits
- Child care and pet benefits
- 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
- In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
- 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
- Subsidized commuter benefits
- Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership
